title: blob-server: BlobBackend trait, register_blob_handlers, mode/range/order helpers
description:
Design: docs/design/blobext.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: B4. Crates: jmap-blob-server. Size: M.

Fix the public surface of crate-jmap-blob-server per docs/design/blobext.md §5 and §6: backend.rs (BlobBackend: JmapBackend with every hook in the §6 table and its default/no-default rule; lookup_type_capability default = jmap_types::data_types::data_type filtered on can_reference_blobs, decision 14; no blob_set_atomic hook, decision 1), lib.rs (register_blob_handlers registering Blob/get, Blob/set, Blob/lookup, Blob/convert via the sibling reg! macro; public handle_blob_* stubs returning serverFail; Blob/upload is added later by B11), mode.rs (BlobMode::from_using: both blob and blob2 -> Conflict, blob only -> Rfc9404, else Blobext; decision 11), range.rs (select_range with checked arithmetic, UTF-8 helpers), order.rs (topo_order with cycle members). Unit tests for range (isTruncated table incl. u64::MAX), order (chains, cycles) and mode. Acceptance: public-api snapshot fixed so B7-B10 do not touch it; clippy clean; rustdoc on every hook contract (spec section cited).
